mock_source: T v88 build_case/make_release on supplied A_bg, with B as reference
selection: Component-wise highest development mean among candidates whose style mean never falls more than 0.02 below T and whose independent diagnostic mean never exceeds T by more than 0.02; ties prefer first declared option. Freeze before confirmation; do not select on confirmation.
official_feedback_used: Only aggregate R v1 feedback and the prior matched comparison motivated robustness checks; no official queries or truth used.
limitations: Existing T person partitions and benchmark are previously used, not fresh unseen people.
Scores are local proxies without official AIA floor phi; no prediction of official score.
R v1 uses joint MIA across 22 targets. M-only scores on this single-target T benchmark are diagnostics, not a reproduction of full R v1 MIA.
This benchmark supplies no known-private mask; production applies the independently proven own-163 mask.
Do not modify the submitted R v1 files or upstream M/T frozen assets.
